email_subject: Application - Junior AI Strategist at Board of Innovation
email_body:
Dear Robin Vermeulen,

I'm applying for the Junior AI Strategist role at Board of Innovation. Your work on AI-native growth for companies like Walmart and Coca-Cola is exactly the kind of first-of-its-kind thinking I want to contribute to.

My background sits at the intersection of AI, code and digital growth. I use LLMs daily for research and audits, have built MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools, and automate repetitive work with Python. I've also designed and launched an Android app and built websites with structured data and AI-search visibility in mind. That hands-on, no-code-plus-code mix means I can move from insight to prototype quickly.

I'm based in Belgium, eager to learn from your team, and ready to take ownership of client deliverables from day one. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can support BOI's AI strategy work.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Robin Vermeulen,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior AI Strategist position at Board of Innovation. What draws me to BOI is the chance to work on first-of-a-kind AI projects for ambitious clients, and to learn how AI strategy is built from first insights to final delivery. That's the environment I want to start my career in.

My experience sits where AI, code and digital growth meet. As a freelance SEO and AI search specialist, I use LLMs daily for research, content and audits, and I've built MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools to automate repetitive work. I've also developed an Android app live on Google Play and built websites with structured data and AI-search visibility in mind. This mix of no-code AI tools and hands-on coding means I can translate a problem into a working prototype quickly, then refine it based on what the data shows.

In my current role at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I also manage CMS content and have built a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major retailers and built WordPress sites from structure to content. Across these roles, I've learned to structure problems clearly, prioritize well and take ownership of deliverables, even when the brief is open-ended.

I'm based in Belgium, fluent in English, and comfortable in fast-moving, collaborative teams. I'm eager to learn from you and the team, and to contribute to internal experimentation that advances BOI's AI offering. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my analytical and hands-on skills can support your client work.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
